hooks.name: SiteMaze — Auto commit and push on file save
hooks.description: After any file is saved inside the SiteMaze project, stages all changes, commits with a timestamp, and pushes to origin/main.

action.command: cd "c:\Users\chris.harding-brown\OneDrive - City of Dallas-5516124-G Tenant\Documents\Kiro\SiteMaze" && git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || (git add -A && git commit -m "chore: auto-save commit $(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)" && git push origin main)
